```{r load}
log_open("03")
P <- readRDS(file.path(RES, "prepared.rds"))
gender_int <- as.integer(P$gender)          # 1 = Group 1, 2 = Group 2
GRID <- seq(-4, 4, by = 0.05)
```

Models:

* **Rasch, CML** (`eRm::RM`): conditional ML, no distributional assumption for θ;
  item locations normalised to sum zero; person parameters by ML (`eRm` default).
* **1PL, MML** (`mirt`): one slope common to all items, θ ~ N(0,1). This is the
  Rasch model in marginal form (common slope = SD of θ on the logit scale). It is
  fitted as a 2PL with an equality constraint on the slopes rather than with
  `itemtype = "Rasch"`, because the latter estimates a latent SD of about 2.5 on a
  fixed quadrature grid (±6), which truncates the latent distribution and
  understates the log-likelihood.
* **2PL, MML** (`mirt`): free slopes, θ ~ N(0,1).

```{r fit-function}
fit_rule <- function(rule) {
  X <- as.matrix(if (rule == "A") P$bin_A else P$bin_B)
  out <- list(rule = rule, p = colMeans(X))

  ## Rasch by CML ------------------------------------------------------------
  rm <- eRm::RM(X)
  out$b_cml  <- -rm$betapar                   # eRm reports easiness
  out$b_cml  <- out$b_cml - mean(out$b_cml)   # sum-zero normalisation
  out$se_cml <- rm$se.beta
  pp <- eRm::person.parameter(rm)
  ifit <- eRm::itemfit(pp)
  out$infit <- ifit$i.infitMSQ;  out$outfit <- ifit$i.outfitMSQ
  out$infitZ <- ifit$i.infitZ;   out$outfitZ <- ifit$i.outfitZ
  th_ml <- pp$theta.table[, "Person Parameter"]
  out$theta_ml <- th_ml
  out$lr_median <- eRm::LRtest(rm, splitcr = "median")
  out$lr_gender <- eRm::LRtest(rm, splitcr = gender_int)
  out$wald_gender <- eRm::Waldtest(rm, splitcr = gender_int)

  ## 1PL and 2PL by MML -----------------------------------------------------
  sv <- mirt::mirt(as.data.frame(X), 1, itemtype = "2PL", pars = "values")
  m1 <- mirt::mirt(as.data.frame(X), 1, itemtype = "2PL", SE = TRUE, verbose = FALSE,
                   constrain = list(sv$parnum[sv$name == "a1"]))
  m2 <- mirt::mirt(as.data.frame(X), 1, itemtype = "2PL",   SE = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)
  out$m1 <- m1; out$m2 <- m2
  out$anova <- anova(m1, m2)
  cf <- mirt::coef(m2, IRTpars = TRUE, printSE = TRUE)
  out$a  <- sapply(cf[ITEMS], function(z) z["par", "a"])
  out$b  <- sapply(cf[ITEMS], function(z) z["par", "b"])
  out$se_a <- sapply(cf[ITEMS], function(z) z["SE", "a"])
  out$se_b <- sapply(cf[ITEMS], function(z) z["SE", "b"])
  out$rasch_sd <- mirt::coef(m1, simplify = TRUE)$items[1, "a1"]
  out$M2 <- tryCatch(mirt::M2(m2), error = function(e) NULL)
  out$itemfit <- tryCatch(mirt::itemfit(m2, fit_stats = "S_X2"), error = function(e) NULL)
  out$Q3 <- tryCatch(residuals(m2, type = "Q3", verbose = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)

  ## information and precision ---------------------------------------------
  out$grid <- GRID
  out$info_items <- sapply(seq_len(ncol(X)), function(j)
    mirt::iteminfo(mirt::extract.item(m2, j), GRID))
  out$info2 <- mirt::testinfo(m2, GRID)
  out$info1 <- mirt::testinfo(m1, GRID)
  fs <- mirt::fscores(m2, method = "EAP", full.scores.SE = TRUE)
  out$theta <- fs[, 1]; out$se_theta <- fs[, 2]
  # marginal reliability: 1 - mean(SE^2) / (var(EAP) + mean(SE^2))
  out$marg_rel <- 1 - mean(out$se_theta^2) / (var(out$theta) + mean(out$se_theta^2))
  out$marg_rel_mirt <- mirt::marginal_rxx(m2)

  ## CTT comparison ----------------------------------------------------------
  out$rpb <- sapply(seq_len(ncol(X)), function(j) cor(X[, j], rowSums(X[, -j])))
  out$sum <- rowSums(X)
  out
}
irt <- list(A = fit_rule("A"), B = fit_rule("B"))
```

# Results by rule

```{r report, results = "asis"}
for (r in c("A", "B")) {
  o <- irt[[r]]
  cat("\n\n## Rule", r, if (r == "A") "(0 vs 1–3, primary)" else "(0–1 vs 2–3, sensitivity)", "\n\n")
  cat("```\n")
  cat("Item parameters:\n")
  print(format(data.frame(item = 1:21, sub = substr(SUBSCALE_OF[ITEMS], 1, 1), p = o$p,
                          b_cml = o$b_cml, se_cml = o$se_cml, infit = o$infit, outfit = o$outfit,
                          a = o$a, se_a = o$se_a, b = o$b, se_b = o$se_b, r_pb = o$rpb,
                          row.names = NULL), digits = 3))
  cat("\nModel comparison (mirt):\n"); print(o$anova)
  cat("\nAndersen LR, median split:  LR =", round(o$lr_median$LR, 2), " df =", o$lr_median$df,
      " p =", signif(o$lr_median$pvalue, 3), "\n")
  cat("Andersen LR, gender split:  LR =", round(o$lr_gender$LR, 2), " df =", o$lr_gender$df,
      " p =", signif(o$lr_gender$pvalue, 3), "\n")
  cat("\nWald test by gender (items with p < .05):\n")
  w <- o$wald_gender$coef.table; print(round(w[w[, 2] < .05, , drop = FALSE], 3))
  if (!is.null(o$M2)) { cat("\nM2 limited-information fit of the 2PL:\n"); print(round(o$M2, 4)) }
  if (!is.null(o$itemfit)) { cat("\nS-X2 item fit (2PL), items with p < .05:\n")
    f <- o$itemfit; print(f[f$p.S_X2 < .05, ]) }
  if (!is.null(o$Q3)) {
    q <- o$Q3; q[lower.tri(q, diag = TRUE)] <- NA
    top <- order(abs(q), decreasing = TRUE, na.last = NA)[1:8]
    cat("\nLargest Yen Q3 residual correlations (2PL):\n")
    print(data.frame(i = ITEMS[row(q)[top]], j = ITEMS[col(q)[top]], Q3 = round(q[top], 3)))
  }
  peak <- GRID[which.max(o$info2)]
  cat(sprintf("\nTest information: max %.2f at theta = %.2f; SE_min = %.3f\n",
              max(o$info2), peak, 1 / sqrt(max(o$info2))))
  cat(sprintf("theta range with I >= 5 (rel >= .80): [%.2f, %.2f]; with I >= 10 (rel >= .90): [%.2f, %.2f]\n",
              min(GRID[o$info2 >= 5]), max(GRID[o$info2 >= 5]),
              min(GRID[o$info2 >= 10]), max(GRID[o$info2 >= 10])))
  cat(sprintf("Marginal reliability: %.4f (EAP formula) | %.4f (mirt::marginal_rxx)\n",
              o$marg_rel, o$marg_rel_mirt))
  cat(sprintf("Common 1PL slope (= SD of theta in logits): %.3f\n", o$rasch_sd))
  cat(sprintf("Mean ML person location (eRm, finite): %.3f\n", mean(o$theta_ml[is.finite(o$theta_ml)])))
  cat(sprintf("cor(b, p) = %.3f | cor(a, r_pb) = %.3f | cor(theta_EAP, sum) = %.4f | Spearman = %.4f\n",
              cor(o$b, o$p), cor(o$a, o$rpb), cor(o$theta, o$sum),
              cor(o$theta, o$sum, method = "spearman")))
  cat("NOTE: eRm infit/outfit use ML person estimates (extreme scores excluded).\n")
  cat("```\n")
}
```

# Numbers for the essay and save

```{r numbers}
for (r in c("A", "B")) {
  o <- irt[[r]]
  num(paste0("AMin", r), f2(min(o$a)));  num(paste0("AMax", r), f2(max(o$a)))
  num(paste0("BMin", r), f2(min(o$b)));  num(paste0("BMax", r), f2(max(o$b)))
  num(paste0("BcmlMin", r), f2(min(o$b_cml))); num(paste0("BcmlMax", r), f2(max(o$b_cml)))
  num(paste0("MaxInfo", r), f2(max(o$info2)))
  num(paste0("MaxInfoTheta", r), f2(GRID[which.max(o$info2)]))
  num(paste0("SEMin", r), f2(1 / sqrt(max(o$info2))))
  num(paste0("RelRange", r), sprintf("[%.1f, %.1f]", min(GRID[o$info2 >= 5]), max(GRID[o$info2 >= 5])))
  num(paste0("MargRel", r), dec(o$marg_rel, 3))
  num(paste0("LRT", r), f2(o$anova$X2[2]))
  num(paste0("AndersenLR", r), f2(o$lr_median$LR))
  num(paste0("AndersenDF", r), o$lr_median$df)
  num(paste0("AndersenGenderLR", r), f2(o$lr_gender$LR))
  num(paste0("ThetaSum", r), dec(cor(o$theta, o$sum), 3))
  num(paste0("CorrBP", r), dec(cor(o$b, o$p), 3))
  num(paste0("CorrARpb", r), dec(cor(o$a, o$rpb), 2))
  num(paste0("InfitMin", r), f2(min(o$infit)));   num(paste0("InfitMax", r), f2(max(o$infit)))
  num(paste0("OutfitMin", r), f2(min(o$outfit))); num(paste0("OutfitMax", r), f2(max(o$outfit)))
  num(paste0("MeanPersonLoc", r), f2(mean(o$theta_ml[is.finite(o$theta_ml)])))
  num(paste0("AIConePL", r), formatC(mirt::extract.mirt(o$m1, "AIC"), format = "f", digits = 0))
  num(paste0("AICtwoPL", r), formatC(mirt::extract.mirt(o$m2, "AIC"), format = "f", digits = 0))
  num(paste0("BIConePL", r), formatC(mirt::extract.mirt(o$m1, "BIC"), format = "f", digits = 0))
  num(paste0("BICtwoPL", r), formatC(mirt::extract.mirt(o$m2, "BIC"), format = "f", digits = 0))
}
saveRDS(irt, file.path(RES, "irt_binary.rds"))
log_close()
```
